change_log.value: Tool router integration for specialty identification

FEAT-2-S148.title: Implement Core Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S148.description: Implement the dual-pipeline specialty identification logic combining regex extraction and vector-based matching, including AI-driven query expansion, NUCC code mapping, deduplication, and confidence scoring.

FEAT-2-S149.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Tool Router
FEAT-2-S149.description: Integrate specialty identification into the tool router with proper input validation and allowlist configuration, enabling LLM tool-use to trigger NUCC specialty mapping during conversations.
